svg.title: The Cross of Victoria: construction sheet
svg.desc: A dimensioned construction drawing of the proposed flag of Victoria at 1:2, with a table of standard proportions and the colour specification.

g.text: Construction sheet. Proportion 1 : 2, height to width. Stars near the arm ends.
Every dimension is given as a ratio of the hoist, A.
Seven points, one point up. Inner radius 4/9 of H.
DERIVED: D = 0.30 C · E = C + 2D · G = 0.872 C · H = 0.447 C
The Cross of Victoria. Designed by Brodie Geoffrey Dunn.
